## 计算函数

以下为会话中实际用于 Optdigits 首达实验的 JavaScript 函数；数据需按上述行号从 UCI 官方文件解析并填入 D.train/D.val 与 testKey。原划分测试时 testKey 为 [原始行号,{x:原像素0–16,y:类别}]。替代划分只替换 D 的 train/val。准确率版及 Semeion 版在本次会话中由字符串替换得到，替换规则见主研究页。

```javascript
function run(testKey,seed0,storeKey){const D=load("optdigits_64split"),test=[...new Map(load(testKey)).entries()].sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]).map(z=>({x:z[1].x.map(v=>v/16),y:z[1].y})),h=8,d=64,K=10,etaPrep=.05,etaCont=.5,etaB=.5,N=800,H=300,c=Math.sqrt(3.013424295774648/(3.013424295774648+.7754896566901408));let seed=seed0;function u(){seed=(1664525*seed+1013904223)>>>0;return (seed+.5)/4294967296}function n(){return Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(u()))*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*u())}function init(scale){return {A:Array.from({length:h},()=>Array.from({length:d},()=>scale*c/2*n())),a:Array(h).fill(0),B:Array.from({length:K},()=>Array.from({length:h},()=>n()/Math.sqrt(h))),b:Array(K).fill(0)}}function fw(m,x){const z=m.A.map((w,j)=>Math.tanh(w.reduce((s,v,l)=>s+v*x[l],m.a[j]))),q=m.B.map((w,k)=>w.reduce((s,v,j)=>s+v*z[j],m.b[k])),mx=Math.max(...q),ex=q.map(v=>Math.exp(v-mx)),sum=ex.reduce((a,b)=>a+b);return {z,q,p:ex.map(v=>v/sum),ls:mx+Math.log(sum)}}function ev(m,data){let L=0;for(const o of data){const f=fw(m,o.x);L+=f.ls-f.q[o.y]}return L/data.length}function step(m,data,etaA){const GA=Array.from({length:h},()=>Array(d).fill(0)),ga=Array(h).fill(0),GB=Array.from({length:K},()=>Array(h).fill(0)),gb=Array(K).fill(0);for(const o of data){const f=fw(m,o.x),p=f.p;p[o.y]-=1;for(let k=0;k<K;k++){gb[k]+=p[k];for(let j=0;j<h;j++)GB[k][j]+=p[k]*f.z[j]}for(let j=0;j<h;j++){let dz=0;for(let k=0;k<K;k++)dz+=m.B[k][j]*p[k];dz*=1-f.z[j]*f.z[j];ga[j]+=dz;for(let l=0;l<d;l++)GA[j][l]+=dz*o.x[l]}}const cA=etaA/data.length,cB=etaB/data.length;for(let j=0;j<h;j++){m.a[j]-=cB*ga[j];for(let l=0;l<d;l++)m.A[j][l]-=cA*GA[j][l]}for(let k=0;k<K;k++){m.b[k]-=cB*gb[k];for(let j=0;j<h;j++)m.B[k][j]-=cB*GB[k][j]}}const selected={S:[],W:[]};for(let i=0;i<N;i++){const scale=u()<.5?.25:3,z=init(scale);for(let e=0;e<5;e++)step(z,D.train,etaPrep);const val=ev(z,D.val);if(val>=2.05&&val<2.10)selected.S.push({i,scale,z,val,g:"S"});else if(val>=2.20&&val<2.25&&selected.W.length<60)selected.W.push({i,scale,z,val,g:"W"})}const out=[];for(const v of [...selected.S,...selected.W]){const L0=ev(v.z,test),t={t16:L0<1.6?0:null,t12:L0<1.2?0:null};for(let e=1;e<=H;e++){step(v.z,D.train,etaCont);if(t.t16!==null&&t.t12!==null)break;const L=ev(v.z,test);if(t.t16===null&&L<1.6)t.t16=e;if(t.t12===null&&L<1.2)t.t12=e}out.push({i:v.i,g:v.g,scale:v.scale,val:v.val,L0,...t})}store(storeKey,out);function st(g){const a=out.filter(x=>x.g===g);return {n:a.length,L0:a.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.L0,0)/a.length,t16:a.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.t16??301),0)/a.length,t12:a.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.t12??301),0)/a.length,censor12:a.filter(x=>x.t12===null).length}}return {S:st("S"),W:st("W")}}
```
